name: pnpm
description: Installs pnpm using the official install script from pnpm/get.pnpm.io

version.description: Version of pnpm to install. Accepts a full version (e.g. 11.24.0), a bare major (e.g. 11), or a dist-tag (e.g. latest, next-12). Maps to the PNPM_VERSION environment variable of the install script.

pnpmHome.description: Directory where pnpm is installed. Maps to the PNPM_HOME environment variable of the install script. The default is shared so that the binary stays accessible to every container user.
